seeding.note: Every eligible profile with a permitting_url and no frontier was attempted in both states. Failures remain explicit review gaps; none were marked successful.

Historical provenance_violations is retained from prior receipts; runs 23-24 did not perform a separate per-document live provenance audit.

latest_verification.tests: 29/29 discovery continuation/frontier/scan tests passed in sandbox

rate_limit_handling: Serialized all seed/drain work after parallel runs triggered repeated 429 'entity read traffic volume' limits; paced calls and retry-tolerant batches; partially truncated batches left profiles eligible (never falsely marked complete).
protected_data: No manual/pinned/archive-protected record was modified; all writes used guarded same-version persistence; no client/job/shared records touched; no authority or applicability conclusions drawn.
